professionalSummary.headline: Senior Staff Full-Stack & AI Systems Engineer with 10+ years of proven success
professionalSummary.tagline: Lead, sole or key developer on every project
professionalSummary.bio: Senior Staff Full-Stack & AI Systems Engineer with 10+ years of proven success architecting elite digital products, high-throughput Fintech/InsureTech infrastructure, and advanced AI integrations. Recognized for entering complex, high-stakes environments to engineer custom technical solutions, rescue failing critical paths, and architect systems from zero to production or acquisition. Deeply versatile across systems programming, concurrent functional paradigms and enterprise ecosystems
professionalSummary.languages: Spanish and English native, Italian basic
highlights: EdTech Leadership & M&A: Spearheaded the B2B product at Clutch Prep that drove its acquisition by Pearson. Co-architected Pearson Channels nearly from the ground up and engineered the critical, highly complex data migration pipeline from relational databases to Pearson's NoSQL infrastructure with zero downtime.
Scalable Social Infrastructure: Acted as a core backend developer in the foundational stages of Truth Social, optimizing the Ruby on Rails infrastructure alongside Mastodon core developers.
FinTech & High-Stakes Recovery: Saved a critical launch at SecureBancard by single-handedly executing 80% of the architecture for Dual BIN support, preventing project failure.
Fully engineered PMX Affiliate Marketplace and seamlessly integrated it into the Shopify ecosystem.

AI Architecture & Compliance: Successfully navigated compliance to launch GRCTechMe on the Google Workspace Marketplace. Expert in secure LLM orchestration (Gemini, Claude), secure enterprise AI portals, and custom audio TTS synthesis pipelines (e.g., edge-tts).

InsureTech & Automation Architect: Engineered InsurAdmin from scratch, a robust platform managing complex carrier feeds and agency teams. Developed the core infrastructure for Agency Rocket, including proprietary automation parsers and complex Stripe billing frameworks.
Nebulith: Creator and lead architect of a proprietary, highly optimized custom game engine, launching to the commercial market soon.
Deep Learning: Actively engineering custom neural network architectures from scratch to bridge the gap between traditional backend systems and custom AI agents.
